info.title: API.SH: DuckDuckGo
info.description: The DuckDuckGo API from API.SH: public DuckDuckGo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
DuckDuckGo web results (about 10 on page 1, 15 after): position, title, destination URL, displayed URL, snippet, favicon; ads and the instant answer separately. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page (null on the last page); `page` up to 5 also works but re-reads the earlier pages. With `include=instant_answer`, also `instant_answer` (heading, entity type, abstract with source and link, image, direct answer and its type, definition, official website, infobox facts as label/value pairs, related topics) and `related_searches`. With `vertical=videos`, video results instead (about 60 per call: title, page URL, description, duration, publisher, uploader, publish date, views, embed URL, thumbnails, motion preview), filterable by time, duration, resolution and license; pass `next_offset` back as `offset`. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/duckduckgo-search

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region code such as us-en, uk-en, de-de, fr-fr (wt-wt = no region, default).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: instant_answer: also return the instant answer and related searches (web only).

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Only results from the past day, week, month or year (videos: day, week or month).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Videos only: short, medium or long.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Videos only: high or standard definition.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Videos only: `next_offset` from the previous call.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
